item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 07/May/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure over central China will edge closer to the coastal areas of southern China tomorrow. Meanwhile, under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be showers and squally thunderstorms over the region. A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will bring slightly cooler weather to the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong early next week. An active southwesterly airstream will bring unsettled weather to the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Hagupit now in the vicinity of Guam will develop gradually in the next few days, and move in the general direction of the seas east of the Philippines.
